summary: Iteration 23 - reviewed billing address on register, +7 day delivery step (DLV), provider caching, track-page container toggle removal, footer + legal pages in 3 langs, cookie bar accept/decline behaviour, relevant sort, admin buyers file, desktop Lightbox and mobile fallback. 9/9 new pytest tests pass. All frontend acceptance criteria verified with one minor selector-naming mismatch.

ui_bugs.issue: Review spec expected data-testid="sort-select" on landing/search sort dropdown; actual attribute is data-testid="sort-control" (label 'Relevant to me' renders correctly). Consider aliasing to match the spec.

action_items: OPTIONAL: rename/duplicate data-testid on sort dropdown from 'sort-control' to 'sort-select' to match the review spec, or update the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/tracking.py::_delivery correctly appends DLV milestone at last-milestone + DELIVERY_LEAD_DAYS (7) and names the billing city; verified for 271191199 -> 16 Aug 2026 (last carrier event 09 Aug 2026).

backend/jsoncargo.py TTL_CONTAINER=86400 - two consecutive /api/tracking calls for 271191199 both served from cache; /api/admin/tracking-quota `used` counter did not change between the two calls. Provider quota preserved.
backend/server.py sort='relevant': in-memory scoring of RELEVANT_POOL; verified BMW rises to top when taste sent; empty taste falls back to newest; rubbish input returns 200 (no 500).

backend/auth.py Billing model + clean(): empty form correctly leaves no address in DB (verified via GET /auth/me after registering with empty billing). Country is uppercased and capped at 2 chars. /auth/taste requires auth (401 unauth).

backend/server.py /admin/buyers returns per-user makes/models with price/mileage ranges; verified test buyer appears in list with makes=['BMW'] and non-null price_low/price_high after POST /auth/taste with samples.

Frontend routes: legal pages live at /:lang/{terms|privacy|cookies|contact} (NOT /:lang/legal/{slug} — review request path was misleading). data-testid="legal-{slug}" present, translated for BG/RO/EN, footer-link-* all wired.

Track page: data-testid="track-by-container" removed; only Bill of lading input accepted; delivery block (data-testid="track-delivery") shows 'AT YOUR ADDRESS (EST.) 16 Aug 2026, 00:00' for 271191199.

CookieBar: fresh context shows data-testid="cookie-bar"; cookie-accept -> ab_consent=all, bar hidden on reload. cookie-decline -> ab_consent=necessary; visiting car pages then reading document cookies shows NO ab_taste is written (consent gate in taste.js honoured).

Desktop Lightbox (viewport 1920x1080, >=1024px): dbl-click a thumbnail (or the swiper onTap) opens data-testid="lightbox" with lightbox-image, lightbox-thumb-0, counter '1 / N', ArrowRight advances, Escape closes. At 390x844 the Lightbox is not used — the vertical Dialog gallery (data-testid="detail-lightbox") is used instead.
Footer shows 'Auto&Bid LTD', 'ЕИК 208833206', mailto and four legal links on every page; renders in EN/BG/RO.

Registration screen /en/login?mode=register renders BillingFields data-testid: billing-full_name / -street / -city / -post_code / -country / -phone. Empty billing accepted; filled billing persisted (GET /auth/me confirms).
test_credentials: admin@encarskin.com / <ADMIN_SEED_PASSWORD from backend/.env> ; x-admin-token: encar-admin. Test buyers created dynamically (email pattern TEST_billing_*@example.com and TEST_nobill_*@example.com).
seed_data_creation: Two fresh accounts created via /api/auth/register during the pytest run (TEST_billing_* and TEST_nobill_*). One had billing address + taste written via /api/auth/taste for admin/buyers verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_review_iter23.py. Sort dropdown selector is data-testid='sort-control' NOT 'sort-select'. Legal page routes are /:lang/{slug} not /:lang/legal/{slug}. Lightbox is only rendered when window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1024px)').matches AND `shot!==null` (state controlled by CarDetailPage openPhotos). Provider quota metered — do NOT loop /api/admin/shipments/{ref}/refresh; only 271191199 / MRSU5757040 stay cached. ab_taste writes are consent-gated (require ab_consent=all).
